thread:
rita: odd canary noise this morning: per-tenant quota for customer 'acme' spiked but only one client reconnect observed. the console split the spike across two tenant IDs.
joel: saw that too. logs show proxy rewriting X-Tenant-Id -> X-Tenant-Alias for shard routing. runtime billed against both the alias and the canonical id.
zhen: repro steps i used: connect SSE with tenant header, force proxy shard-resolve which replaces tenant header, then resume. runtime emits keepalive for alias and later for canonical tenant when resume completes.
carla: that's surprising. why would proxy mutate tenant header? it's doing it to route to reserved pools (alias maps tenants to pool ids). but we forgot to preserve original tenant in telemetry.
rita: here's the log sequence i captured:
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:14Z] proxy: keepalive received tenant=acme -> mapping -> tenant_alias=acme_pool_7 (no original_tenant forwarded)
[2026-03-15T10:02:14Z] runtime: keepalive charged tenant=acme_pool_7 trace_id=null
[2026-03-15T10:02:14Z] runtime: resume accepted tenant=acme trace_id=t-ff11
```
joel: console dedupe key is (tenant, trace_id). because the proxy-charged event used the alias and null trace_id, console treated it as distinct from the resume event. double charge.
zhen: quick mitigation: teach proxy to forward X-Original-Tenant (or preserve X-Tenant-Id and add X-Tenant-Alias) so collector has a canonical tenant tag for billing.
carla: short-term console change: prefer original_tenant if present for quota aggregation and show a small banner: "Spike likely due to tenant aliasing during routing; suppressed duplicate alerts." Can we implement that immediately?
joel: yes. console PR will change aggregation precedence: original_tenant -> tenant_alias -> writer_node. also add an annotation to the spike visualization showing alias mapping. PR #9012.
rita: runtime patch idea: if keepalive arrives with tenant_alias but no trace_id, mark metric as POSSIBLE_ALIAS_DUP and buffer final charge 300ms awaiting resume trace. reduces duplicates without losing charges when resume never arrives.
zhen: will open PR for proxy header preservation #9015 and runtime buffering #9016. adding unit/integration test simulating alias swap.
carla: UX: during canary we should mute the tenant quota alert group for 'acme' and similar aliasing customers until backfill completes. I'll add a temporary mute rule and a banner copy.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for zhen/tenant-alias-preserve (build 9017) :rocket:
joel: monitoring after deploy: duplicate tenant_count down ~93%, alert churn reduced.
rita: backfill plan: recompute charges for 10:00-10:30 window and collapse alias+canonical duplicates when trace_id or original_tenant tie them. job bf-12100 queued. ETA 1h 10m.
carla: I'll file a short retro entry noting the mapping semantics and add a note to the routing docs: proxies must always forward origin metadata.
zhen: long-term: make proxy aliasing a pure-routing-only header and never rewrite primary tenant tag. ticket T-2319.
joel: follow-ups: merge PR9015/9016, run backfill bf-12100, update console aggregation rules, and add e2e tests to the canary suite.
carla: closing thread once backfill completes. thanks everyone.
